⏺ Sound half committed on main as dd51cea. Notifications work done both halves:

  Badge (2a4d58d) — one needsAttention predicate, blocked and done identical, feeding five surfaces:
  - agent list cards: hoisted into a "Needs you (n)" section, .agent.attention highlight, moved not copied
  - app tab strip: red dot on .agent-tab.alert, flashing 1.6s
  - Space chips: .chip.alert::after, same flash
  - browser tab: (n) herdr-remote title + red favicon circle
  - Projects cards say "needs you"

  Ack is per status, in localStorage. Opening a pane clears it; the same pane going blocked then later done speaks up again. syncAcked drops acks whose status no
  longer matches, so stale/recycled pane IDs can't arrive pre-silenced.

  Sound (dd51cea) — chime on transition into either attention status, from whichever message carries it (snapshot or agent_update), deduped once per snapshot.
  Removed the duplicate chime in the blocked handler — relay broadcasts the snapshot first, so it was ringing twice for one event. shouldSound stays quiet only for
  the pane you're watching with the tab in front of you; a backgrounded phone on that same pane still rings.

  CDN dropped. esm.sh/cuelume replaced with ~25 lines of inline WebAudio covering all nine cue names. Two wins beyond the single-file property: a LAN relay with no
  route out / strict CSP / offline PWA launch was silent, and silently (call sites are if (window.cue)); and the module was deferred, so early cues never played
  at all.

  Tests: 15 in tests/test_attention.js (vm slice), 7 browser specs in tests/e2e/browser/attention.spec.js including one that asserts no off-host request and that
  all nine cues build without throwing.

  Green: node 157/0, Playwright 28, Python 236 OK, both e2e ALL PASS. Nothing pushed — main is 16 ahead of origin/main.

  One thing I flagged and built as you chose: done and blocked look identical, so at a glance you can't tell which pane is holding up work versus merely finished.
  One-line divergence later if it bites.
